findings.message: T09's public conflict-resolution input is not yet an implementable contract. previewMigration(root,{mapping,limits}) says mapping resolves actor aliases, missing metadata/routes, unknown status and reviewed plan edits, but neither migration-design.md nor migration-findings.md defines allowed keys, value types, source-observation identities, rationale/original-value binding, or how a mapping proves it cannot lower a counter or override consistent evidence. Builder and test author could produce different accepted JSON, and apply would otherwise risk treating an arbitrary caller object as migration authority. Freeze a small versioned mapping schema and whether limits are fixed production maxima or caller-reducible bounds before implementation.

The recovery API leaves journal id allocation and rollback scope unstated. A compatible routine choice is one versioned journal per preview_id under .deliver/migrations/, with typed write/remove operations retaining exact before/after kind, mode and bytes; recover operates only while that journal is incomplete, and a completed applied marker is not a general migration undo command. Pin this in tests even if it does not need another design document.

summary: Bounded readiness assessment only, not a final T09 review. Existing support is limited but useful: project-state detects pm/pm-state.json or tmp/pm-state.json and routes legacy state to migration; pm.mjs supplies the canonical salted actor-id algorithm, bounded regular-file/symlink checks, local lock plus exact before-image journal pattern, strict current supported 0.22 actor/core parsing, and round-trip evidence that criteria, unknown fields, counters and handoffs survive the supported bridge. story.mjs supplies strict current story parsing and Execution replacement. None of T09's production module, CLI, reference, migration tests or fixtures exists yet. The existing migrate operation is only a placeholder routed to recovery.md. Missing implementation: bounded multi-era inventory; local and already-present remote branch blob inspection without fetch; credible observation grouping; newest status/branch plus per-counter MAX; explicit ambiguity mapping; exact preview identities and write/remove/retain list; current+legacy DRIFT; plan edit and object-format approval digest; merged-lineage proof; retained unknown legacy evidence; typed apply journal, resume/rollback and idempotent applied record; old-run history and forced fresh binding/baseline; migrate CLI and native route. Acceptance tests should cover v0.7 tmp, v0.8 flat pm, v0.9 bare actor aliases and v0.10.1+ actor records; integration and open local/remote branch copies; decreasing counters and conflicting timestamps; teammates/parallel entries/routes/unknown statuses; exact criteria and raw unknown retention; PASS-only versus reachable merged lineage; mixed-format and changed HEAD/ref/index/tracking/dirty/before-image rejection; modified/untracked legacy retention and exact clean tracked removals including .gitattributes; approval pending versus credible approval after exact plan transformation; apply interruption at journal/artifact/story/plan/approval/removal/applied boundaries; resume, rollback, third-state refusal and rerun idempotence; symlink/FIFO/oversize/path escape rejection; preview/import side-effect freedom; no stdin/provider/fetch; and byte-identical existing .deliver runs with no old PASS reuse after migration. Follow migration-design/findings where the upstream migration prose conflicts, especially pre-0.10.1 alias handling and retained dirty history.
